title: Evidence-Centered Design for Prototypes
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting evidence-centered design for prototypes to prototype README traceability matrix connecting theory to screen changes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: State the three ECD layers used here: claim (what the learner knows or can do), evidence (the observable that would reveal it), task (the screen that elicits the observable).
Audit a traceability matrix row for the two classic failures: an unobservable evidence cell and a task that cannot elicit the named observable.
Rewrite an internal-state evidence cell ("feels confident") as a scorable behavior.
Reject task features that produce data unrelated to the claim.
